categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the design and manufacturing of various power transmission cables and connectors, including AC/DC power cords for personal computers, home appliances, cloud computing, IoT devices, smart devices, gaming consoles, new energy vehicles, electric vehicles, industrial and low-earth orbit satellite outdoor power cords, and environmentally friendly low-halogen and halogen-free cables. It serves international brand customers, large home appliance manufacturers, electronic OEMs, and professional power supply manufacturers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes including molding, injection molding, terminal crimping, and automated production lines. It focuses on multi-functional, high-power, and aesthetically designed cables, complying with global safety certifications (UL, CSA, VDE, PSE, etc.). It integrates upstream processes such as copper wire drawing and PVC pellet production, and invests in automation to improve efficiency and reduce labor costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international well-known brands, large home appliance manufacturers in Europe and America, domestic and foreign electronic OEMs, and power supply manufacturers. The end markets span consumer electronics, computer systems and peripherals, communication products, electric vehicles, aerospace, and medical equipment industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Asia, with significant sales in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, and expanding presence in the Americas and Europe. It has production bases in Huizhou, China, and a new factory in Vietnam to serve global markets, especially targeting US and European customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing and assembling power and signal transmission cables. It also vertically integrates upstream by producing raw materials such as PVC pellets and copper wire processing, enhancing supply chain stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include optimizing manufacturing processes and automation, strengthening R&D capabilities focused on automotive, low-earth orbit satellite, and AI-related power cables, and developing environmentally friendly products compliant with global regulations. The company aims to innovate in Type-C connectors, high-speed data transmission cables, and high-power industrial and medical plugs, while expanding global certifications and customer base.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power transmission cables and connectors to international brand customers and OEMs. The company also benefits from licensing and certification compliance as part of its product offerings, with no subscription or advertising revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in power and signal cable manufacturing with over 40 years of experience, recognized for quality and extensive global certifications. It competes against numerous small and medium connector manufacturers, with industry trends favoring larger firms with scale and automation. The company differentiates through vertical integration, automation, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$4.07 billion, a 3.91% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$223 million. Despite a slight decline in net profit margin due to increased costs, the company maintains stable growth and is investing in automation and R&D. It employs nearly 2,000 staff and continues expanding production capacity, including a new Vietnam plant operational in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, certified, and environmentally friendly power and signal cables tailored to meet diverse customer needs across multiple industries. Its competitive advantages include extensive global safety certifications, vertical integration of raw material supply, advanced automated manufacturing, and strong R&D focused on emerging technologies such as AI, electric vehicles, and satellite communications. This enables it to provide reliable, innovative, and cost-effective solutions with stable long-term customer partnerships.
